harnessTicket.secretsTitle: This change may contain a real credential
harnessTicket.secretsBody: agnts flagged {n, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} as a possible secret or a dotenv file. Check them in the red flags on the Review tab: agnts does not push the change until you confirm they are not real credentials.
harnessTicket.secretsConfirm: I checked them: not real credentials
harnessTicket.secretsDone: Confirmed: the flagged lines are not real credentials.
harnessTicket.secretsNeeded: First confirm that the lines flagged as secrets are not real credentials.
harnessTicket.proofHelp_proven: The reproducing test fails on the code before the change and passes after it.
harnessTicket.proofHelp_not_reproduced: The test passes before the change too, so it does not show the bug.
harnessTicket.proofHelp_still_failing: The test still fails with the change.
harnessTicket.proofHelp_inconclusive: The test could not run on the code before the change; it may need what the fix adds.
harnessTicket.proofHelp_no_test: No automated test reproduces the bug.
harnessTicket.proofHelp_error: agnts could not run the proof.
harnessTicket.coveragePct: {pct}% of the changed lines ran in the tests ({covered} of {total})
harnessTicket.coverageNone: No changed line is code the coverage report measures.
harnessTicket.dropped: {n, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}} left out (low confidence or duplicates)
